summary: Retested strict DD-MM-YYYY validation and core mobile preview flow. Public API returns the expected Jakarta blueprint and rejects ISO/impossible dates; city selection, calculation, result display, language toggle, and back navigation pass.
action_items: Align frontend/.env and frontend API configuration with the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL variable; current preview uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and the regression test could not obtain EXPO_BACKEND_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL before EXPO_BACKEND_URL, while the environment contract requires EXPO_BACKEND_URL; this is currently masked by the preview environment.
Result UI exposes only Type, Authority, and Profile as requested.

success_rate.backend: 100% direct public requests (pytest harness unavailable due missing EXPO_BACKEND_URL)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://birth-chart-app-17.preview.emergentagent.com. Direct POST results: DD 200 => Projector/Mental/4/6; ISO 400; 31-02-1990 400. Mobile viewport 375x667 passed form, language toggle, city picker, calculation, result values, and back navigation.
rca_of_issue: Iteration 1's ISO fallback is removed and strict datetime.strptime('%d-%m-%Y %H:%M') now correctly rejects noncanonical and impossible dates. The added pytest file reads EXPO_BACKEND_URL as required, but the checked-in frontend/.env only defines EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, so pytest requests had no URL; direct public endpoint verification passed.
